facts.summary: Halted development after insufficient B cell depletion; 73% layoffs · Phase 1b · imvotamab in RA and SLE · not yet approved
facts.indication: rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus

evidence.summary: Interim data from the Phase 1b studies of imvotamab in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus show that the depth and consistency of B cell depletion is insufficient to meet our high bar for success
evidence.program_discontinued: Due to these findings, we have decided to discontinue further development of imvotamab.
